message_text: Zone A conveyor configuration changed after the commissioning test window. The carton divert rule now sends order-flow test totes to the wrong lane and the handover checklist is paused until engineering reviews the configuration issue.
End-to-end acceptance test for station P12 is failing with repeated scanner timeout errors. The test team needs the incident reviewed before the afternoon retry window.

Daily SQL validation found a mismatch between picked quantity and inventory adjustment totals for the synthetic night shift fixture. Please route the data validation issue for review before the report is handed over.
The operations lead needs a review of the handover blocker list, owner notes, rollback comments, and missing proof for the synthetic warehouse release checklist.
